content.text: hypogonadism (endocrinopathy or aging w low testosterone) may ↓ libido and cause ED, but erectile funct only rarely improves w normal testosterone (most also have neurovascular causes); underlying disorders such as hypogonadism need their own tx.

Boxed: virilization reported in children secondarily exposed; children should avoid unwashed or unclothed application sites. CI: breast CA or known or suspected prostate CA in men; CI: pregnancy (may cause fetal harm). Check Hct b4 starting, at 3 to 6 months, then annually; if elevated, stop until it falls. Suspected VTE: stop and work up. BPH may worsen: monitor pts w BPH; evaluate for prostate CA b4 and during tx. Can ↑ BP: check BP periodically (esp in HTN); ⍉ recommended in uncontrolled HTN.
